response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with relevant exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. While his direct GenAI/RAG experience is limited, his technical leadership, cloud platform familiarity, and open-source contributions suggest adaptability for the role. An interview would clarify his fit for production-grade AI workflows.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (8+ years) with TypeScript, Python-adjacent languages (Dlang), and cloud platforms (AWS).
Proven technical leadership in customer-facing roles, including mentorship and cross-functional collaboration.
Hands-on contributions to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP) and developer tooling at re:cinq.
concerns: Limited explicit experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM performance optimization.
No advanced degree in AI/CS (only a Bachelor's in Computer Science).
Diverse but fragmented project history may dilute deep expertise in GenAI/cloud infrastructure.
